original_sql:
SELECT f.film_id, f.title
FROM film f
WHERE f.film_id NOT IN (SELECT i.film_id FROM inventory i)

candidates.rationale: Converts NOT IN to a LEFT JOIN and checks for NULL, which can be faster than NOT IN.
